part.text: Fixed. The bug was in `Tokenizer.stateInRCDATA` (packages/compiler-core/src/tokenizer.ts:459): when inside RCDATA elements (`<textarea>`, `<title>`), the tokenizer started interpolation on `{` without checking `this.inVPre`, so `{{` inside a `v-pre` textarea was parsed as an interpolation (and swallowed the rest of the content when no closing `}}` existed). Adding the `!this.inVPre` guard — consistent with `stateText` (line 327) — makes `{{` plain text in that case, while non-`v-pre` textarea interpolation still works. Verified with a manual parse check and the full compiler-core/compiler-sfc/compiler-dom suites (1156 tests pass).
